items.quote: Clara told us which rooms would need work before we asked. We bought the house knowing what we were taking on, with a budget that held.
items.name: Hannah and Leo M.
items.alt: Hannah and Leo standing close and smiling in a garden beside a stone wall.

items.quote: We were selling from another state. Thomas sent photos of every repair and a short note each Friday until the keys changed hands.
items.name: Ana and Marcus R.
items.alt: Ana and Marcus embracing in front of a burnt-orange studio backdrop.

items.quote: Maya showed us four lofts in one afternoon and told us plainly that two of them were noisy. We signed for the third and still like it.
items.name: Jess and Tom K.
items.detail: Rented in the West Loop, Chicago
items.alt: Jess and Tom in denim and knitwear, leaning their heads together and smiling.

items.quote: Elena's valuation came in lower than we hoped, and she showed us the sales behind it. We priced the house on her figure and had no regrets.
items.name: Robert A.

items.quote: Owen walked the dune with us and pulled the flood insurance history before we made an offer. That conversation kept us from buying the wrong house.
items.name: Priya S.

items.quote: Daniel answered every question about the inspection, including the ones I sent late at night. He never pushed me to raise my offer.
items.name: Sam W.
